I'm Dr. Joey Munoz.

I hold a PhD in Nutritional Sciences from Florida State University, and I've been a personal trainer working with clients for over a decade.

At eleven, I was the overweight kid, and the strict diets that came after taught me to fear food.

Fitness and flexible eating changed that, and I learned the missing piece was never motivation; it was the right system, the right education and the right support.

That became the Strong Standard Method™: Strategy, Education and Accountability.

Today my team coaches busy professionals one-on-one with it: people who are doing the work, or who keep starting over.

What is the
Strong Standard Method™?

It's the method I built, and the one every coach on my team works from.

Most people who train hard and eat well are following the wrong recipe for the result they want.

The usual recipeEat less, add more cardio and watch the scale.
The Strong Standard Method™Strength training first, fueling properly instead of restricting more, and muscle front and center.

Here's why the usual recipe stalls: the less muscle you carry, the harder it gets to lose weight, so cutting more and adding cardio works against you.

The method is built to help you build muscle, lose fat and protect your health for the years ahead.

That's the recipe.

Strategy, Education and Accountability are how you stick to it in a real week, across three phases.

01

Strategy

A plan built like a GPS for your real week: evidence-based so it works, shaped around your life so you can stick to it, and recalculated when life pulls you off course.

02

Education

You learn the why behind every step, so when progress stalls or life changes, you know what to adjust instead of guessing.

03

Accountability

Your coach checks in every week and is there every day in the app, until the habits run on their own, like brushing your teeth.

Your six months move through three phases:

Phase 1 · Foundation

  • About 8 weeks of building the habits and behaviors first
  • The focus is on what you do each day, not on the scale
  • Like a house, the foundation goes in before the walls

Phase 2 · Body Composition

  • Your plan is tailored to lose fat or to build muscle
  • Your nutrition and your training are both built around keeping and adding muscle

Phase 3 · Lifestyle

  • You learn to keep your results in a way that feels easy
  • You learn to stop tracking everything you eat
  • By the end, you don't need us to hold on to them

Frequently asked questions

When will I hear the price, and what if it doesn't fit my budget?

On the call, before you decide anything.

We'll walk you through every way to pay, so you can see what fits your month.

Can I spread the cost out?

Yes.

You can pay in full or spread it out, and we'll go through both on the call.

Can my spouse or partner join the call?

Yes, please bring them.

If you make money decisions together, it helps for them to hear the plan and the price from us directly.

What if I need time to think?

That's fine, and it's a fair thing to want.

On the call, tell us what's still on your mind, whether it's the money, the coach or your partner, and we'll go through it with you plainly.

Who will I be working with?

You'll work one-on-one with a coach on Dr. Joey's team, and Dr. Joey oversees the whole program.

Your coach holds a master's degree, a PhD or a health license, and you also have direct access to Dr. Joey.

If your coach isn't the right fit, we'll switch you to another one.

Is six months right for me, and what happens after?

You commit to six months because that's how long it takes to learn the why, build the habits and work through a few setbacks with your coach.

By the end, the goal is for you to keep your results on your own, without us.

Are the results on this page real?

Yes, every before-and-after photo and every quote here belongs to a named Strong Standard client.
